description: This PHP class defines a data model named EmployeeTimesheetModel used for serializing and representing timesheet data related to employees in a Human Resource Management system. It sets entity filters and attribute mappings for serialization purposes.

classes.name: EmployeeTimesheetModel
classes.description: A model class for serializing employee timesheet data in the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor method that initializes the model with a Timesheet entity and configures serialization filters and attribute mappings.
